source_attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; September 20 2023 FOMC statement.

claims.text: 联邦基金目标利率区间维持在 5-1/4 至 5-1/2（5.25%–5.5%），美联储决定维持不变。

citations.quotation: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.

claims.text: 后续政策将考虑的因素：继续评估新增信息及其对货币政策的影响。

citations.quotation: The Committee will continue to assess additional information and its implications for monetary policy.

claims.text: 在决定进一步政策幅度时，委员会将考虑货币政策的累计收紧、货币政策影响经济活动和通胀的滞后性、以及经济和金融发展。

citations.quotation: the Committee will take into account the cumulative tightening of monetary policy, the lags with which monetary policy affects economic activity and inflation, and economic and financial developments.

claims.text: 委员会还将继续缩减其持有的资产。

citations.quotation: the Committee will continue reducing its holdings
